title: The concept and historical development of transport
competency: Explain what transportation is and how it developed over time.

keywords.def: The movement of passengers, animals and goods from one place to another.
An animal used to carry goods or people, like a donkey, mule, horse or camel.

en.text: Transportation is the movement of passengers, animals and goods from place to place. Long ago people only walked. Then they used animals, then wooden carts. After the industrial revolution, modern transport let people travel far in a short time.

screens.title: The first transport
screens.ask: Long ago, before carts and cars, how did people travel?
screens.after: At first people only walked. Later they used animals and then carts.

screens.title: 2.3.1 The concept and historical development of transport
paras: Transportation is the movement of passengers, animals and goods from one place to another.
Early on, there was no transport except walking.
Then people used animals to travel and carry things on land.
People invented the wooden cart. After the industrial revolution, modern transport was invented.

screens.title: Transport today
paras: Trips that took days or months now take minutes or hours.
Fast transport and communication make places all over the earth closer to each other.
